name: jev-decision-gate
description: Local Issue triage, optional Jev judgments and independently calibrated acceptance gates.

data_root.title: Issue JSON directory
data_root.description: An existing trusted local directory containing JSON files you authorize the tool to read.

allow_jev.title: Enable paid Jev calls
allow_jev.description: Allow selected Issue title/body text to be sent to TypeSafe. Off by default; rules work without a key.

api_key.title: TypeSafe API key (optional)
api_key.description: Only needed when enabling Jev. Use the host's protected configuration; never paste it into a chat.

max_calls.title: Maximum Jev calls per invocation
max_calls.description: Integer limit per tool invocation, not a daily or account spending limit.
